answer: Attackers must fund every fake identity with real collateral, so forging N sybils costs N times the minimum stake, making large-scale deception economically irrational while honest agents recover their deposits. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a jade-bonded deposit before voting, and the consensus kernel slashes that bond if duplicate identities share a registration footprint, like water tracing the same karst channel.
